argv:
Rewrite the text in dense corporate business jargon.

Replace concrete nouns with abstractions. Turn verbs into nominalisations:
prefer "the utilisation of" to "using". Use the passive voice so that no
sentence names who acts. Reach for "leverage", "synergy", "stakeholder",
"alignment", "operationalise", "value-add", and "at scale".

Hedge every claim. Add qualifying clauses that commit to nothing.

Keep the underlying facts of the original technically present, however deeply
buried. This column exists as a demonstration of what these habits cost.

request.user_prompt:
Rewrite the passage below according to your style instructions.

Output only the rewritten passage. Do not add a preamble, a title, an
explanation, or any commentary about the changes you made.

<passage>
Notwithstanding anything to the contrary elsewhere in this Agreement, in the event that the Subscriber elects to enable the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (as such term is defined in Schedule C, which Schedule may itself be amended from time to time in a manner not inconsistent with the general purposes of this Section), it is agreed and understood that any and all Usage Data collected in connection therewith, whether or not such Usage Data is subsequently aggregated, anonymized, or otherwise processed by or on behalf of the Service, shall, unless a written objection is received within the period specified in Schedule D, be deemed to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis. The Subscriber's continued use of the Service following any modification to this clause shall be construed as acceptance thereof, and it is acknowledged that certain notifications regarding such modifications may, at the Service's sole discretion, be delivered solely through the Subscriber's account dashboard rather than by direct communication.
</passage>

response.text:
Notwithstanding any potential misalignment with other provisions herein, and without prejudice to the general operationalisation of stakeholder value across the ecosystem of this Agreement, it is to be understood, insofar as such understanding may be operationalized at scale, that in circumstances where an election is made toward the enablement of the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On functionality (as such construct is notionally defined, on a non-exhaustive basis, within Schedule C, itself a living instrument subject to periodic recalibration in a manner broadly consistent with the overarching directionality of this Section), a leveraging of any and all Usage Data touchpoints generated in connection with the foregoing shall be presumed to have occurred — irrespective of whether subsequent aggregation, anonymization, or other value-add processing has been undertaken by or on behalf of the Service — such that, absent a written objection lodged within the timeframe contemplated by Schedule D, said data assets shall be deemed, for synergy purposes, to have been licensed back to the Service on a non-exclusive basis, subject to further clarification as may or may not be forthcoming.

It shall further be understood, without this constituting a binding representation of any kind, that continued engagement with the Service subsequent to any modification of the foregoing clause may be construed, at the discretion of relevant stakeholders, as constituting a form of tacit alignment with such modification. It is additionally acknowledged, for the avoidance of doubt (to whatever extent such doubt is capable of avoidance), that notifications pertaining to modifications of this nature may, at the sole discretion of the Service, be operationalised exclusively through account-dashboard-based touchpoints, as opposed to more direct channels of communication, notwithstanding any expectation to the contrary that may or may not be reasonable under the circumstances.
